headline: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol models are reportedly now 50% faster in products that use “Sign in with ChatGPT”.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: the 50% figure rests on a post on X that the article does not name, relayed by a crypto news site, and no independent test is cited.
importance_line: People who use ChatGPT or apps linked to a ChatGPT account should see answers arrive sooner, and developers who build on that login get a faster product to offer, but the 50% figure rests on a post on X and no independent tests are cited.
source: Crypto Briefing, citing a post on X
summary: Crypto Briefing reports, citing a post on X, that OpenAI's flagship GPT-6 Astra and its cheaper sibling GPT-6.1 Sol now run 50% faster, not only in OpenAI's own chat app but across apps that use “Sign in with ChatGPT”, the login that lets people bring their ChatGPT account into other companies' apps. BigGo Finance credits the announcement to OpenAI's Codex lead, Thibault Sottiaux; Crypto Briefing offers no measurements, so the 50% figure is a claim, not a test result.
